scope: Clearer guides, stronger privacy controls, and more readable text.

topics.title: Choose whether to use online recognition
details: A new Input option asks whether audio may be sent to Azure. It is off by default. Web forms and settings use offline speech.

topics.title: Clearer instructions in every guide
details: Grammar and sentence structure are corrected throughout the manual. Commands explain which words or numbers to add before giving an example. All guide formats use the same instructions.

topics.title: Keep private sign-in data out of saved pages
details: History skips pages with private sign-in codes. Favorites cannot save those page addresses. The app also clears private codes from older saved addresses.

topics.title: Permission for AI speech
details: A service key alone does not allow online narration. Turning permission off clears pending AI speech. Older setups may ask you to confirm permission again.

topics.title: Stronger service checks
details: Account and AI requests stop if a service tries to send them to a new address. This protects keys and account tokens. Routine logs no longer show what you said or read.

topics.title: More readable text
details: Main-window labels wrap when the window gets narrower. Links and focus marks use readable colors. Settings notices are shown as text as well as spoken.
